title: FAA UAP reports, batch 17 (237UAP00455 - 237UAP00482)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA UAP reports; it contains two reports of close-approach encounters involving specific object descriptions rather than just lights.

encounters.summary: Pilot reported a UAP above FL600 flying in an erratic pattern; three lights formed a triangle and merged into one, repeating the process.
encounters.quote: 3 lights appeared to create a triangle and come together as one light

encounters.summary: Pilot reported a round black object that was stationary at approximately 16,000 feet.
encounters.quote: round black object that was stationary
